63:t_1:172.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$ and $n told me I was unsuited to the task and removed me from the team.」

63:t_1:173.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then we're in the same position.」

63:t_1:175.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The repairs to the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ are on track. $$マデューカス$$ and $$サックス$$ are overseeing the rest for me.」

63:t_1:176.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So apparently, my services are no longer needed.」

63:t_1:177.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... The Lieutenant Colonel and the others certainly didn't mean you were useless or anything, Captain...」

63:t_1:178.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I know. Everyone is working hard to let me get some rest.」

63:t_1:179.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But... I feel anxious when I'm not keeping busy...」

63:t_1:181.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We came to $$翠の地球$$ to overthrow the $$新地球皇国$$, yet we still haven't accomplished anything...」

63:t_1:182.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even now, $$蒼の地球$$ must be facing $$サイデリアル$$'s threat, while the $$レイライン$$ is extracting $$次元力$$...」

63:t_1:183.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As their commander, I can do nothing... I've tried to act resolute before my crew, like Captain $$ジェフリー$$, but I don't know how long I can keep it up...」

63:t_1:186.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If you say something kind to me now, $$相良$$, I... I think I'll start crying...」

63:t_1:191.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I see... I think I understand those 《$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$》 now.」

63:t_1:192.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, that surprised me. You were fighting $$サイデリアル$$ in the center of the galaxy too.」

63:t_1:194.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I've heard that even the $$フロンティア船団$$ can't fold over very long distances while the dimensional boundaries are unstable...」

63:t_1:195.en:
$n
「So even hyperspace travel has its limits...」

63:t_1:197.en:
$$甲児$$
「I didn't quite understand how it happened, but the people of that $$人類銀河同盟$$ are descended from Earthlings, right?」

63:t_1:198.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't know the de-tails ei-ther.」

63:t_1:199.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's why you speak Earth Language. Though yours sounds a little funny.」

63:t_1:203.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yep, yep. That's a good sign.」

63:t_1:204.en:
$n
「He wasn't the quiet type. He just didn't know how to communicate.」

63:t_1:205.en:
$n
「In other words, he was just like me.」

63:t_1:206.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You hold more of a grudge than I expected, $n...」

63:t_1:207.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Anyway, since you've got nowhere to go, you're part of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ too.」

63:t_1:209.en:
$$レド$$
「Wel-come...? I don't know... that word.」

63:t_1:210.en:
$$ティファ$$
「It means we're happy to have you here.」

63:t_1:212.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This isn't the middle of the galaxy, and our enemies aren't the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. You're going to follow the way we do things here.」

63:t_1:213.en:
$$ガロード$$
「For starters, no more of what you did yesterday.」

63:t_1:214.en:
$$レド$$
「You mean when I tried to pur-sue the en-e-my...」

63:t_1:215.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's right. They'd already lost the will to fight.」

63:t_1:216.en:
$$レド$$
「I was just try-ing to e-lim-i-nate the en-e-my.」

63:t_1:217.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Well... Sure, they're our enemies. But that doesn't mean we need to take lives for no reason.」

63:t_1:218.en:
$$レド$$
「...I don't... un-der-stand what you're say-ing...」

63:t_1:219.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This seems to be a matter of ethics and rules, rather than language...」

63:t_1:222.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...Can I have a word?」

63:t_1:223.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$, she's the one who brought you up from the sea.」

63:t_1:225.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You said your name was $$レド$$, right? Thank you for helping the fleet yesterday.」

63:t_1:227.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「I hate saying this to someone we owe so much, but taking lives is more strictly forbidden here than anything else.」

63:t_1:228.en:
$$レド$$
「...But... You kill liv-ing crea-tures for food.」

63:t_1:229.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「True, we kill and eat fish and birds. But only as much as we need to live. We don't kill needlessly.」

63:t_1:230.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「And pirates are humans... Our own kind. You can't take their lives lightly.」

63:t_1:233.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「This is a multiverse. If we started saying people aren't human just because they're from another planet, where would it end?」

63:t_1:234.en:
$$レド$$
「...If hu-mans are for-bid-den to harm each oth-er, why do you have wea-pons?」

63:t_1:235.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Leaving $c aside, when it comes to this fleet...」

63:t_1:236.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Pirates threaten to kill to make people obey. So we show them that we won't just quietly let them kill us.」

63:t_1:237.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「As long as we're just showing off our cannons to each other, it's basically a negotiation.」

63:t_1:238.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...We have a saying: 'Give fresh water to those who bring fish.'」

63:t_1:239.en:
$$レド$$
「Is that a say-ing that en-cour-ages hu-mans to help each oth-er?」

63:t_1:240.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That's right. We can't survive unless everyone brings something to share.」

63:t_1:241.en:
$$甲児$$
「So that's why the fleet helped us.」

63:t_1:242.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$c protected the fleet from $$サイデリアル$$ yesterday, too. We're friends already.」

63:t_1:245.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「No, it's nothing... That's for $$リジット$$ and the Fleet Commander to think about.」

63:t_1:247.en:
$$レド$$
「I un-der-stand your views. But the pi-rates and $$サイデリアル$$ do not fol-low those rules.」

63:t_1:248.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Of course we can't accept that. We won't give our lives or belongings to a bunch of pirates.」

63:t_1:249.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「But all we need to do is make them understand that attacking us won't pay.」

63:t_1:250.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Once people die, though, it's different. They'll have to spill more blood to regain their standing, or they won't be able to back down.」

63:t_1:253.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Even so, it's a fact that you fought to protect the fleet.」

63:t_1:254.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「I'm grateful for that. Let me thank you again.」
